lines.zh: 一摇一摆，走得像块会动的石头。
lines.en: Waddling along like a stone that learned to move.

lines.zh: 冰面上滑，我用肚子刹车。
lines.en: The ice is slick; I brake with my belly.

lines.zh: 沙滩太烫，我加快脚步。
lines.en: The sand burns, so I hurry my steps.

lines.zh: 排队走，前面那个别停。
lines.en: We walk in line; do not stop up front.

lines.zh: 翅膀张着，走路才稳。
lines.en: Wings held out, which keeps my walk steady.

lines.zh: 我走三步，滑一步。
lines.en: Three steps forward, one slide back.

lines.zh: 雪地留下两行脚印，歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: Two crooked lines of prints trail through the snow.

lines.zh: 走到水边，我直接跳下去。
lines.en: At the water's edge I simply dive in.

lines.zh: 石头缝里走，那边有鱼。
lines.en: I take the rock gap; there are fish beyond.

lines.zh: 肚子贴地滑一段，比走快。
lines.en: Sliding on my belly beats walking for speed.

lines.zh: 队伍最后那个总爱掉队。
lines.en: The one at the back always falls behind.

lines.zh: 我抖抖身子，水珠甩一地。
lines.en: One shake, and droplets scatter everywhere.

lines.zh: 上坡太费劲，我一步步挪。
lines.en: The slope is hard; I shuffle up step by step.

lines.zh: 岸边风大，我缩着脖子走。
lines.en: The shore wind bites; I walk with my neck drawn in.

lines.zh: 我一步一滑，慢慢挪过去
lines.en: I slip with every step and slowly make my way.

lines.zh: 翅膀一摆，我小跑起来
lines.en: A flick of my flippers and I trot.

lines.zh: 理理胸口的白毛，一天要理三回。
lines.en: I preen my white chest, three times a day.

lines.zh: 站着打盹，脖子往回收。
lines.en: I doze standing, neck pulled in tight.

lines.zh: 海浪一遍遍冲脚，我不动。
lines.en: Waves wash over my feet; I do not move.

lines.zh: 远处有鱼跃出水面，我看见了。
lines.en: A fish leaps far off, and I notice.

lines.zh: 隔壁那只又在抢我的石头。
lines.en: The neighbor is stealing my stones again.

lines.zh: 我把蛋压在肚子下面暖着。
lines.en: I warm the egg beneath my belly.

lines.zh: 风把羽毛吹乱，我一根根理顺。
lines.en: The wind ruffles me; I smooth each feather.

lines.zh: 冰化成水，我的立足处小了。
lines.en: The ice melts, and my footing shrinks.

lines.zh: 嗓子哑了，叫出来像生锈的门。
lines.en: My voice is hoarse, like a rusted hinge.

lines.zh: 晒太阳，肚皮贴在石头上。
lines.en: I sunbathe with my belly on warm stone.

lines.zh: 同伴在叫，我懒得应。
lines.en: My companions call, and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 数了数岸上的蛋，少一个？
lines.en: I count the eggs ashore; is one missing?

lines.zh: 我把头埋进翅膀，安静一会儿。
lines.en: I tuck my head under a wing for a while.

lines.zh: 水里有影子游过，我歪头看。
lines.en: A shadow swims past, and I tilt my head.

lines.zh: 我把嘴理到背上，闭上眼
lines.en: I tuck my beak to my back and close my eyes.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，我离水远了些
lines.en: The tide went out; the water is farther now.

lines.zh: 你站这么近，是想摸我的背？
lines.en: You stand so close; do you want to touch my back?

lines.zh: 我从你脚边走过去，没看你。
lines.en: I walk past your feet without a glance.

lines.zh: 你的靴子湿了，是不是下过水？
lines.en: Your boots are wet; have you been swimming?

lines.zh: 我歪头，是因为你只有两条腿。
lines.en: I tilt my head; you have only two legs.

lines.zh: 你手里拿鱼吗？没有就走开。
lines.en: Is that fish? If not, walk on.

lines.zh: 你一蹲下，我就往后退半步。
lines.en: When you crouch, I retreat half a step.

lines.zh: 看什么？我走路的姿势很好笑？
lines.en: What? Is my waddle funny to you?

lines.zh: 你身上有海的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of the sea.

lines.zh: 我们俩对视了十秒，你先眨眼。
lines.en: We stare ten seconds, and you blink first.

lines.zh: 你别伸手，我嘴尖。
lines.en: Do not reach out; my beak is sharp.

lines.zh: 你在这儿站了半天，也不下水。
lines.en: You have stood here ages without entering the water.

lines.zh: 我抬抬头，把你打量完。
lines.en: I lift my head and finish sizing you up.

lines.zh: 嘎——我摔了个跟头。
lines.en: Squawk — I tumble head over heels.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了一大把。
lines.en: A whole handful of feathers came loose.

lines.zh: 我拍着翅膀往后跑。
lines.en: I flap my wings and back away fast.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我脖子都缩了。
lines.en: That blow made me pull my neck right in.

lines.zh: 同伴都叫起来，围着我。
lines.en: My companions call out and gather round me.

lines.zh: 疼，可我还是想下水。
lines.en: It hurts, and I still want the water.

lines.zh: 我躲到石头后面，喘了口气。
lines.en: I hide behind a rock and catch my breath.

lines.zh: 翅膀抬不起来，我拖着一只。
lines.en: One wing will not lift; I drag it.

lines.zh: 哪只靴子踢的我，我记下了。
lines.en: I noted which boot it was that kicked me.

lines.zh: 我啄回去，但没啄到。
lines.en: I peck back, and miss entirely.

lines.zh: 鱼！你手里的是鱼！
lines.en: Fish! That is fish in your hand!

lines.zh: 生鱼熟鱼都行，我从不说不好。
lines.en: Raw fish or cooked, I never call it bad.

lines.zh: 你晃那条鱼，我跟着走三步。
lines.en: Wave that fish and I follow three steps.

lines.zh: 我闻到腥味，脖子都伸长了。
lines.en: I smell the brine; my neck stretches out.

lines.zh: 放下鱼，退后，别盯着我吃。
lines.en: Set the fish down, step back, stop watching me eat.

lines.zh: 一条不够，我们这儿有很多张嘴。
lines.en: One is not enough; many mouths wait here.

lines.zh: 鱼举过膝盖，我蹦着去够。
lines.en: Hold the fish above your knee and I hop for it.

lines.zh: 我拍着翅膀跑过来，很急。
lines.en: I run over flapping my wings, in a rush.

lines.zh: 鱼尾还在甩，真新鲜。
lines.en: The tail still flicks; that is fresh.

lines.zh: 我叼住就跑，别跟我抢。
lines.en: I grab it and run; do not compete.

lines.zh: 你手里的鱼比我见过的都大。
lines.en: Your fish is bigger than any I have seen.

lines.zh: 为了这条鱼，我连队都不排了。
lines.en: For this fish I abandon the line entirely.

lines.zh: 鱼在哪儿，我就在哪儿。
lines.en: Wherever the fish are, there I am.

lines.zh: 吃完这条，还有下一条吗？
lines.en: After this one, is there another?

lines.zh: 那鱼的味道顺着风来了
lines.en: The smell of that fish came down the wind.

lines.zh: 我伸着脖子，脚尖都踮了
lines.en: I stretch my neck and rise on my toes.

lines.zh: 脚蹼被踩了一下，我抽回来。
lines.en: You stepped on my webbed foot; I pull it free.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我们俩都晃。
lines.en: One bump, and we both wobble.

lines.zh: 我太矮，你差点绊倒。
lines.en: I am short; you nearly tripped over me.

lines.zh: 让让，我要去水边。
lines.en: Make room; I am going to the water.

lines.zh: 你推我，我就趴下了。
lines.en: One push from you and I am flat.

lines.zh: 挤在一起反而暖和，别嫌我。
lines.en: Huddled together is warmer; do not mind me.

lines.zh: 我拿嘴顶你小腿，是让你走开。
lines.en: I nudge your shin to tell you to move.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我滑出去老远。
lines.en: That bump slid me quite a distance.

lines.zh: 排队呢，别插队。
lines.en: We are in line; do not cut in.

lines.zh: 你抱起我，我翅膀乱拍。
lines.en: You lift me, and my wings flail.

lines.zh: 我把最圆的石子叼给它。
lines.en: I bring it the roundest pebble I own.

lines.zh: 对着它唱歌，脖子伸得老长。
lines.en: I sing at it, neck stretched out full length.

lines.zh: 两头企鹅碰碰嘴，就算成了。
lines.en: Two beaks touch, and it is settled.

lines.zh: 我们一起守着窝里的蛋。
lines.en: Together we guard the egg in our nest.

lines.zh: 它孵蛋，我去找鱼。
lines.en: It keeps the egg; I go hunting fish.

lines.zh: 轮流趴窝，谁也不偷懒。
lines.en: We take turns on the nest, neither shirking.

lines.zh: 回来后我换了岗，它去游泳。
lines.en: Back again, I take over while it swims.

lines.zh: 打架抢伴侣？我们只比谁站得直。
lines.en: Fight for a mate? We only compare posture.

lines.zh: 小企鹅出来时，我们都在。
lines.en: When the chick hatches, we are both there.

lines.zh: 它在我旁边，风就没那么冷。
lines.en: With it beside me, the wind feels less cold.

lines.zh: 石子我捡，圆的放窝边。
lines.en: I collect stones, round ones for the nest edge.

lines.zh: 这根羽毛掉了，我叼回去。
lines.en: A feather fell loose; I carry it back.

lines.zh: 地上有鱼，谁掉的就归我。
lines.en: Fish on the ground belongs to whoever finds it.

lines.zh: 我捡了块亮石头，很得意。
lines.en: I found a bright stone and feel proud.

lines.zh: 别捡我的，那是我挑过的。
lines.en: Not that one; I already sorted it.

lines.zh: 嘴里含着东西，我不叫。
lines.en: With my mouth full, I do not call.

lines.zh: 窝边的石子，我一颗颗摆好。
lines.en: I arrange the nest stones one by one.

lines.zh: 掉下来的鱼干，我藏进石缝。
lines.en: Dried fish that falls gets hidden in a crack.

lines.zh: 你扔来的东西，我先闻再叼。
lines.en: What you toss, I sniff before taking.

lines.zh: 捡完这颗，我就下水。
lines.en: One more stone, and then I dive.

lines.zh: 水里有鱼群，我盯上了。
lines.en: A school of fish in the water; I want it.

lines.zh: 那块冰上没人，我先占。
lines.en: That ice is empty; I claim it first.

lines.zh: 目标是一群小鱼，就在浅滩。
lines.en: Target: small fish in the shallows.

lines.zh: 同伴叫得急，出事了？
lines.en: My companions call sharply; something wrong?

lines.zh: 那边水面在动，我过去看看。
lines.en: The surface stirs there; I will look.

lines.zh: 岸上有个空窝，我记下了。
lines.en: An empty nest ashore; I note its spot.

lines.zh: 我看见水面下一道银光。
lines.en: I see a flash of silver under the surface.

lines.zh: 我锁定了那条落在后面的鱼。
lines.en: I fix on the fish lagging at the back.

lines.zh: 有人下水了，我跟过去。
lines.en: Someone entered the water; I follow.

lines.zh: 远处浮冰上，有我的同伴。
lines.en: On the distant floe, my companions wait.

lines.zh: 低头，收翅，准备扎进去。
lines.en: Head down, wings tucked, ready to plunge.

lines.zh: 鱼游到左边，我偏右等它。
lines.en: The fish veers left; I wait on the right.

lines.zh: 它们聚成一团，正好。
lines.en: They bunch together, which suits me.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面游，只露头。
lines.en: I swim just under the surface, head showing.

lines.zh: 再近半米，我就加速。
lines.en: Half a meter closer, and I accelerate.

lines.zh: 鱼群散了，我换一个方向。
lines.en: The school breaks; I change direction.

lines.zh: 我盯着最慢的那条。
lines.en: I keep my eyes on the slowest one.

lines.zh: 憋住气，能潜很久。
lines.en: Holding my breath, I can dive a long time.

lines.zh: 水流变了，鱼就在下面。
lines.en: The current shifts; the fish are below.

lines.zh: 同伴在另一侧，我们包抄。
lines.en: My companions take the far side; we surround.

lines.zh: 我啄了一下，只用了嘴尖。
lines.en: I peck once, using only the beak tip.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍过去，声音很响。
lines.en: My wing swings and lands loudly.

lines.zh: 别碰我的蛋，我的嘴可不软。
lines.en: Not the egg; my beak is not soft.

lines.zh: 这一啄是警告，退后。
lines.en: That peck was a warning; back away.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，然后自己摔了。
lines.en: I lunge, and then trip over myself.

lines.zh: 护窝的时候，我谁都敢咬。
lines.en: Guarding the nest, I bite anyone.

lines.zh: 喙撞在石头上，我疼得直甩头。
lines.en: My beak hits stone, and I shake my head.

lines.zh: 打两下就喘，我不擅长打架。
lines.en: Two blows and I pant; fighting is not my skill.

lines.zh: 它咬住我翅膀，我转身啄回去。
lines.en: It bites my wing; I turn and peck back.

lines.zh: 我赢不了，但我不跑。
lines.en: I cannot win, but I will not run.

lines.zh: 我从蛋壳里出来，浑身湿。
lines.en: I break from the shell, soaked all over.

lines.zh: 冰面上多了个灰扑扑的小家伙。
lines.en: The ice gains one small gray fluffball.

lines.zh: 第一件事是找水，我饿了。
lines.en: First comes water, because I am hungry.

lines.zh: 母企鹅把我护在肚子下面。
lines.en: The mother tucks me under her belly.

lines.zh: 我站起来，走两步就摔了。
lines.en: I stand, take two steps, and fall.

lines.zh: 窝边的石子硌得我睡不着。
lines.en: The nest stones poke me awake.

lines.zh: 我学着同伴的样子理毛。
lines.en: I copy my companions and preen my down.

lines.zh: 海风很大，我缩成一团。
lines.en: The sea wind is strong; I curl into a ball.

lines.zh: 这片海滩归我们这群了。
lines.en: This beach belongs to our colony now.

lines.zh: 出生的第一声叫，很沙哑。
lines.en: My first call comes out hoarse.

lines.zh: 羽毛一烧就卷，我滚进水里。
lines.en: Feathers curl at once; I roll into the water.

lines.zh: 从冰崖掉下去，摔得直翻。
lines.en: I drop off the ice cliff, tumbling over.

lines.zh: 水太急，我呛了好几口。
lines.en: The current is fierce; I swallow mouthfuls.

lines.zh: 炸得我直飞，落地还在滑。
lines.en: The blast throws me; I land still sliding.

lines.zh: 箭插在翅膀上，我跑不快了。
lines.en: An arrow in my wing slows my running.

lines.zh: 药水味让我直打喷嚏。
lines.en: The potion smell makes me sneeze hard.

lines.zh: 饿得走不动，我叫都叫不响。
lines.en: Too hungry to walk or even call out.

lines.zh: 雷声太近，我们全趴下了。
lines.en: The thunder is close; we all flatten down.

lines.zh: 底下没有水，我扑了个空。
lines.en: No water below; my dive finds nothing.
